Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebServing_Expert failed to utilize its core capability of browsing and analyzing web pages. Instead of directly visiting the Wikipedia page for "Dragon" and checking its edit history (which is the only way to find specific removed text), it relied on a series of ineffective text-based web searches. These searches could not retrieve the specific historical edit data required to solve the problem, leading to a failure to identify the removed phrase "Here be dragons". The expert repeatedly suggested "manual navigation" which is not feasible in a text-only LLM context, yet failed to actually execute a browser-based analysis of the page history as intended by its system instructions.
